description: Infer a JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) from one JSON document or many samples: types (integer vs number), nested objects and arrays, required keys (present in every sample), nullable fields, string formats (date-time, date, email, uri, uuid, ipv4/6) and optionally enums and numeric bounds. Turns API responses into a contract for validation or tool definitions. POST JSON body. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/json-schema-infer

enums.description: Emit enum for low-cardinality repeated strings

samples.description: Several sample documents of the same shape (better required/nullable detection)

name: json_schema_infer
title: Json Schema Infer
